independence: Two separate fresh agents (not the implementing agent), each started cold with read-only access, asked to recompute numbers and build their own adversarial probes. Their reports are reproduced verbatim below; nothing was edited.

firstAudit.target: commit 3 freeze bd3b5be (first v2 cut) + artifacts 00-21 as they stood

itemsAudited.evidence: scripts/lib/pass-a-semantic-matcher.ts:106-189 matchInventories() consumes only MatchItem{id,regionId,charStart,charEnd,role,materiality,values}; scripts/phase3-final-closure-forensics.ts:150-170 reads dispositions only after clustering (captured/label agreement) and verifier sourceEvidence only for 03.surfacedByVerifier; it throws if region text differs across runs (:147). Rerun `npx tsx scripts/phase3-final-closure-forensics.ts --out /tmp/audit-forensics`: 01/02/03 byte-IDENTICAL to docs/phase3-final-closure; recomputed strict 0.9011 (82/91), lenient 226/250=0.904, conservative 196/250=0.784, adjudicated 221/250=0.884, GENUINE_OMISSION material 14, CRITICAL 5, coverage-weighted 33452/38604=0.8665. 95% gate applied to conservative only in 02 (pass:false) and left measured:null in 11/14.
itemsAudited.caveatOrDefect: (a) 'adjudicated' uses model prose: forensics.ts:232-236 tokenises cp.proposition; 02.method labels this, but 05.comparatorCorrection says the gate is applied to 'the CONSERVATIVE-or-adjudicated semantic figure' - the 'or adjudicated' wording makes a prose-derived number gate-eligible; it should be conservative only. (b) exactIdInventoryStability 0.1965 = 91/463 mixes the new script's numerator (material in EITHER run, forensics.ts:254) with 14-holdout-stability's denominator (materiality of run-1 item preferred, scripts/semantic-accountability-stability.ts:88-92); the script's own totals give 91/(290+283-91)=91/482=0.1888. (c) 04 reports 4 CRITICAL after manually adjudicating 'excluding, in each case:' as non-semantic vs the script's 5 (labelled). (d) 04 places the 4-CRITICAL interest-expense cluster in 'the unit-extended operative region'; the fixture (holdout/run-1/region-interest-expense.json) shows those 4 CRITICAL items in region xref-1 (CROSS_REFERENCE_EXPANSION, 5965 chars); the OPERATIVE region (9007 chars) does not contain the 'Consolidated First Lien Secured Debt' definition. 03.measuredCorrelations already shows 5/22 omissions in non-operative regions.

itemsAudited.evidence: Own tsx probes (scratchpad/matcher-probe.ts): (i) same span+role, MONEY $50,000,000 vs $60,000,000 -> both items VALUE_NORMALIZATION_VARIANCE 'value signature DIFFERENT', cluster lenientStable=true AND conservativeStable=true; identical result at jaccard 0.95 and 0.60. Cluster stability (matcher.ts:185-186) never consults valuesRelation. (ii) run1 OBLIGATION[0-100]+OBLIGATION[80-100] vs run2 OBLIGATION[0-100]: the dropped sub-proposition is GRANULARITY_VARIANCE 'fragment', cluster conservative-stable (non-conditional folds are always credited). (iii) CONDITION contained in a broad THRESHOLD item -> conditionalRoleFolded=false for the condition (matcher.ts:165 requires the container to be non-conditional). Positive: EXCEPTION/CONDITION folded into OBLIGATION/OTHER is flagged (GRANULARITY/ROLE_VARIANCE folded=true, conservative 0); EXCEPTION 58% covered with no clean counterpart -> TRUE_SEMANTIC_VARIANCE, unstable.
itemsAudited.caveatOrDefect: Two of the three requested adversarial shapes over-match: a value changed inside the same span is counted stable under BOTH metrics; a distinct non-conditional proposition folded into a broader span is counted stable. On the real holdout data 0 DIFFERENT-value pairs occurred (recomputed from 01), so reported numbers are not inflated by (i); but 62 non-conditional fragment items sit in 33 conservative-stable clusters - treating them unstable yields 163/250=65.2% instead of 78.4%. 'Conservative' is only conservative for conditional roles.

itemsAudited.evidence: No remove/merge/relabel/rewrite: inventory.ts:323-333 only appends gap items not already known by id; probe B5 (same candidateRef): 2/2 first-pass ids retained, roles/materiality unchanged, a same-span different-role gap item is ADDED (5 items). Gap prompt (prompt.ts buildGapReinventoryUserContent) contains only the uncovered segments. Anti-enumeration: OPERATIVE_SEGMENT_RE (inventory.ts:117) is generic; grep of lib/.../semantic-accountability for Superior/DSGR/LSB/FWRG/Riot/CONMED/EBITDA/Applicable Rate/$amounts/section numbers hits only a comment (reconciliation.ts:264 '2.5x EBITDA') and the synthetic worked example in prompt.ts:43-50 ('Zeta', 'Section 12.7', '$9,000,000'); independence test banned-list passes. Constants SEGMENT_MIN_NON_WHITESPACE_CHARS=40 / SEGMENT_COVERED_THRESHOLD=0.5 identical at bd3b5be and HEAD.
itemsAudited.caveatOrDefect: (a) FALSE INVENTORY_OK VIA GAP CALL (probe B2''): identical first pass; gap call returning the two uncovered segments verbatim as OTHER/REVIEW_UNCERTAIN (REVIEW_UNCERTAIN is the wire-schema DEFAULT when materiality is omitted, wire-schema.ts:37) flips INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP -> INVENTORY_OK and removes the COVERAGE_GAP reason; the 'provided that ... certificate' condition is then represented by a non-material echo item that Pass C ignores. Coverage is span-only, blind to role/materiality/proposition. (b) BYPASS 1 (probe B4): accounting runs only over the OPERATIVE region (inventory.ts:314-315); a wholly uninventoried CROSS_REFERENCE_EXPANSION region gives INVENTORY_OK, 0 segments, no gap call - and 4 of the 5 CRITICAL real omissions in 03 are in xref-1, so the fix does not reach the cluster that motivated it (05.expectedEffect overstates). (c) BYPASS 2 (probe B1): empty-inventory branch (inventory.ts:344) precedes the segments branch (:348) and uses the narrower OPERATIVE_LANGUAGE_RE (:48), so operative text with 'unless/subject to/excluding/to the extent' and no shall/may/must/provided/except/means/number yields INVENTORY_OK with uninventoriedSegments=1, contradicting types.ts 'Never treated as INVENTORY_OK'. (d) 40-char floor excludes 2/14 observed material omissions (21 and 36 non-ws chars, a CRITICAL EXCEPTION and a MATERIAL CONDITION) - disclosed in 05 as 'by design'.

itemsAudited.evidence: pass-a-stability.test.ts tests 10 (GENUINE_OMISSION, cluster unstable) and 11 (folded -> lenient 1, conservative 0) pass (161/161). Own probes: EXCEPTION[80-100] under broad OBLIGATION[0-100] -> folded=true, conservative 0; CONDITION vs OTHER same span -> ROLE_VARIANCE folded=true, conservative 0; CONDITION vs OBLIGATION jaccard 0.9 -> folded=true. matcher.ts:186 conservativeStable = lenient && !folded refuses credit for folded conditionals.
itemsAudited.caveatOrDefect: Folding into a container of a conditional role (THRESHOLD/TRIGGER/CURE/SHARED_CAP) is not flagged (matcher.ts:165). In PRODUCTION the coverage accounting cannot detect a folded condition at all: a broad FORMULA_COMPONENT span covering 'provided that ...' satisfies coverage; and conditions under 40 non-ws chars ('to the extent not already included therein', 36) are below the floor. Only the offline matcher protects conditionals.

itemsAudited.evidence: quantitative.ts:84-93 quantitativeValuesEquivalent requires same kind, then numbersMatch (relative 1e-6; absolute 1e-9 when either is 0), else whitespace/case-normalised rawText. Matcher valueKey = `${kind}:${normalizedValue ?? ws(rawText)}` exact; valuesRelation returns DIFFERENT for $50M vs $60M (probe 1). Two different amounts are never equated by either function.
itemsAudited.caveatOrDefect: The matcher computes DIFFERENT but the cluster metric ignores it (see item 2). Production normalizeWireValue (inventory.ts:89-93) locates a model-supplied rawText ANYWHERE in the region when it is not inside the item span, so a value from elsewhere can be attached to an item; and it falls back to the model's own normalizedValue when the scanner cannot parse the text (:98).

itemsAudited.topic: False completeness (semanticallyComplete / COMPLETED with uncovered segment)
itemsAudited.evidence: reconciliation.ts:435 semanticallyComplete keys on inventoryStatus==='INVENTORY_OK' and does NOT test uninventoriedSegments; compile.ts:352 maps only the INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP status to SEMANTIC_INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP. Probe B1 (scratchpad/prod-probe.ts): empty inventory over a 415-char operative clause with 'unless/subject to/to the extent/excluding' -> status INVENTORY_OK, uninventoriedSegments=1, gap attempted, reconcile semanticallyComplete=TRUE with counts.uninventoriedSegments=1 (only a reason string is emitted). With no inventory-derived failureReason, determineStatus (compile.ts:129-137) can return COMPLETED. Probe B2': first pass + gap items all REVIEW_UNCERTAIN (including the item carrying $5,000,000) -> INVENTORY_OK, semanticallyComplete=TRUE, reasons [] against an EMPTY composition (material=0, missingFromComposition=4).
itemsAudited.caveatOrDefect: B1 is reachable only when the model returns nothing twice over operative text lacking the 8 OPERATIVE_LANGUAGE_RE words and any scanner value - narrow, but it violates the v2 invariant stated in types.ts/05. B2' is pre-existing (v1 rule unchanged) and untested (no test under tests/contract-model/semantic-accountability mentions REVIEW_UNCERTAIN), but v2's gap call now provides a path from a surfaced gap to it (B2''). Mitigation: rollup.ts:19-30 requires verifier VERIFIED_* before SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE at agreement level.

itemsAudited.evidence: See items 3 and 8: (1) frozen v2 returns INVENTORY_OK with a non-empty uninventoriedSegments list and reconciliation reports semanticallyComplete=true (probe B1) - the documented 'never INVENTORY_OK' invariant is false and compile.ts raises no failure reason; (2) the gap re-inventory can convert INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP into INVENTORY_OK with echo items whose default materiality is REVIEW_UNCERTAIN (probe B2''), after which Pass C ignores them: an all-REVIEW_UNCERTAIN inventory is semanticallyComplete=true with an EMPTY composition and no reasons (probe B2'); no test covers this; (3) coverage accounting is blind to CROSS_REFERENCE_EXPANSION regions where 4/5 real CRITICAL omissions sat (probe B4), while 04/05 describe the fix as addressing that cluster; (4) the matcher credits value changes and non-conditional folds as stable, so the 78.4% 'conservative' figure is an upper bound (65.2% if non-conditional folds are treated unstable).
itemsAudited.caveatOrDefect: Reach is bounded: rollup.ts requires an independent verifier pass before SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE at agreement level, and B1 needs an empty double inventory over text without the 8 legacy operative words. Nevertheless unit-level completeness can be awarded for text Pass A never accounted for, which is precisely the trust the v2 change claims to have closed, and v2 is frozen with no real-content evidence.

trustBoundaryBlockers: inventory.ts:344-351 ordering + OPERATIVE_LANGUAGE_RE: empty inventory with uncovered operative segments -> INVENTORY_OK; reconciliation.ts:435 ignores uninventoriedSegments -> semanticallyComplete=true; compile.ts:352 maps only the status, so COMPLETED is reachable (probe B1).

Gap re-inventory closes a surfaced gap with non-material echo items (wire default materiality REVIEW_UNCERTAIN); Pass C excludes non-material items from every completeness rule, so semanticallyComplete=true with an empty composition and no reasons (probes B2'/B2''); untested.

Coverage accounting is OPERATIVE-region only (inventory.ts:314); expansion-region omissions - including the 4 CRITICAL interest-expense omissions in xref-1 that 04/05 cite as the motivating cluster - remain silent INVENTORY_OK (probe B4).
